Closes https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/issues/20897

This change updates the default log format in `util/log` from `text` to `json`. It will be used for ArgoCD v3.0.

JSON logging is preferred because it produces structured logs, which are easier to parse and analyze with tools like Datadog and OpenTelemetry (Otel).
